definition: a sturdy cotton twill fabric, used for jeans
hook: Denim is not a fabric name. It is an address.
modernAnchor: Blue jeans. A worn jacket. The one fabric everyone owns. We call it denim.
journey: Nimes, a city in southern France, was known for a tough woven cloth called serge.
Merchants labelled the cloth by where it came from: serge de Nimes, serge from Nimes.
English traders shortened the label and slurred it, and de Nimes became denim.
The city faded from the name and the fabric went on to clothe miners, cowboys and everyone since.
